### Key logic verified

**Resolver fail-closed behavior (`release-availability.mjs`):**  
Every early-return path returns `unavailable` (`verified: false`, `catalogMatches: false`, all features `available: false`). The operator precedence on the `complete` expression (lines 45–46) is correct: `&&` binds tighter than `||`, producing `(A && B) || (C && D) || E`. For companion features (`component !== 'desktop'`), `A` is false and `C` (`feature.variants`) is undefined, so only `features[feature.id].available` decides completeness — correct. Companion features' `null` minimumVersion is never passed to `meets()`. The `!complete` branch (line 47) explicitly resets all feature availability to false rather than leaking partial availability state.

**`generated.json` state:** `verified: false`, `catalogMatches: false`, all features `available: false` — correct for v2.25.147 with no published capability manifest. All conditional copy paths fall to the qualification side: analytics note shows the PR #1819 prepared-fix path, companion features show "source-build availability unverified", Full-only desktop features show "release availability unverified · Full edition only".

**HTML injection safety in `render.ts`:** `featureLabel` and `companionOrigin` use only values from the build-time catalog (hardcoded strings). The `escape` function is applied to all external-derived data (version strings, URLs). No external-data injection path into the new HTML.

**CSS containment:** Exactly two rules added. `.product-section` gets `contain: layout style paint`. Inner elements get `contain: layout style`. No `size` containment, no `content-visibility`, no estimated heights — matches scope precisely.

**Catalog split:** `tool-catalog.mjs` is an exact extraction; `tool-registry.mjs` re-exports the same symbols. `generate-site-data.mjs` imports directly from `tool-catalog.mjs`. `facts.test.mjs` and `release-availability.test.mjs` import directly from `tool-catalog.mjs`. Internal consistency confirmed.

**Security patches:** Root `package.json` adds a scoped KaTeX override for `micromark-extension-math`. Companion lockfile bumps `fast-uri` 3.1.7→3.1.8, `hono` 4.13.1→4.13.13, `qs` 6.15.2→6.16.1. `install-smoke.test.mjs` version pins updated to match.

**Map categories static text:** "weather, internet outages, cyber threats, military activity, waterways, and economic signals" covers all 6 entries from `site.json`; the existing `marketing.test.mjs` test at line 183 verifies each category string appears in both sections.

**Mutation proofs documented:** Schema validation removal and forced analytics-fixed change each produce `7 pass / 0 fail → 6 pass / 1 fail` on `release-availability.test.mjs`. Three additional repair mutations also produce `6/1`.
